introHtml: Full color letter openers allow you to print logos, photos, or intricate designs with vivid detail, making them ideal for corporate gifts or promotional mailings. Unlike single-color imprints, full color captures gradients and fine text, giving your brand a polished, professional look. Choose from plastic or metal styles with a smooth edge for safe, daily use in any office.
